# Generated File Detection

## Overview

workspace-map automatically detects and skips generated files to save tokens and improve summary quality.

## Default Patterns (28)

```json
"generatedPatterns": [
  "*.generated.*", "*.d.ts",
  "dist", "dist/**/*",
  "build", "build/**/*",
  "out", "out/**/*",
  "*.min.js", "*.min.css",
  "coverage", "coverage/**/*",
  ".next", ".next/**/*",
  ".nuxt", ".nuxt/**/*",
  ".output", ".output/**/*",
  "target", "target/**/*",
  "obj", "obj/**/*",
  "*.g.dart",
  "GeneratedPluginRegistrant.*",
  "*.pb.go", "*.pb.ts", "*.pb.js",
  "*_generated.*", "generated_*.*",
  "*.designer.*", "*.autogenerated.*"
]
```

## Behavior

| Aspect | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| **Tree** | Included, marked with `⚙` |
| **Summarization** | Skipped |
| **Cache** | Entry created with `kind: "generated"` |
| **Injection** | Marked in tree, no file note |

## Tree Marker

```
src/
  generated.ts ⚙
dist/
  bundle.js ⚙
```

## JSON Output

```json
{
  "notes": {
    "dist/bundle.js": {
      "summary": "js file · 12345 bytes · generated file (not summarized)",
      "kind": "generated",
      "generated": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration

### Disable

```json
{
  "autoDetectGenerated": false
}
```

### Custom Patterns

```json
{
  "generatedPatterns": [
    "*.generated.*",
    "dist/**",
    "my-custom-generated/**"
  ]
}
```

### Include Generated

```json
{
  "include": ["dist/**", "*.d.ts"]
}
```

## Pattern Syntax

| Pattern | Matches |
|---------|---------|
| `*.generated.*` | Any file with `.generated.` |
| `dist/**/*` | All files under `dist/` |
| `dist` | Directory named `dist` |
| `*.min.js` | Files ending in `.min.js` |
| `*.generated.ts` | Files ending in `.generated.ts` |

## Categories

| Category | Patterns |
|----------|----------|
| **Build outputs** | `dist/**`, `build/**`, `out/**` |
| **TypeScript** | `*.d.ts` |
| **Minified** | `*.min.js`, `*.min.css` |
| **Coverage** | `coverage/**` |
| **Framework** | `.next/**`, `.nuxt/**`, `.output/**` |
| **Compiled** | `target/**`, `obj/**` |
| **Flutter** | `*.g.dart`, `GeneratedPluginRegistrant.*` |
| **Protobuf** | `*.pb.go`, `*.pb.ts`, `*.pb.js` |
| **Generated suffix** | `*_generated.*`, `generated_*.*` |
| **IDE generated** | `*.designer.*`, `*.autogenerated.*` |

## In Injection

### Tree View
```
src/
  generated.ts ⚙
```

### JSON
```json
{
  "tree": {
    "children": [{
      "name": "src",
      "children": [{
        "name": "generated.ts",
        "rel": "src/generated.ts",
        "file": true,
        "generated": true
      }]
    }]
  }
}
```

## Best Practices

1. **Keep defaults** - Covers 95% of generated files
2. **Add custom patterns** - For project-specific generators
3. **Use include** - Override for files you want summarized
4. **Check tree** - Verify `⚙` markers in injected map
